name: @pipeworx/mcp-docket-alarm

tools.name: docketalarm_search
tools.description: Search court dockets (state + federal) for `<query>` — full-text search across 675M+ US state, county, and federal court dockets (deeper state coverage than CourtListener). Returns matching cases with court, docket number, title, filing date, and link. Example: docketalarm_search({ q: "patent infringement Apple", limit: 20, _apiKey: "user@example.com:yourpassword" })

q.description: Full-text search query. Supports fielded search, e.g. is:docket "Acme Corp".

offset.description: Starting offset into the result set (for pagination).

_apiKey.description: Docket Alarm credentials as "username:password" from your docketalarm.com account.

tools.name: docketalarm_get_docket
tools.description: Get full docket detail for a case — returns case title, parties, filing date, and docket entries for a specific court + docket number. Cached documents are free. Example: docketalarm_get_docket({ court: "U.S. District Court, N.D. California", docket: "5:11-cv-01846", _apiKey: "user@example.com:yourpassword" })

court.description: Full court name, exactly as returned by docketalarm_search (e.g. "U.S. District Court, N.D. California").

_apiKey.description: Docket Alarm credentials as "username:password" from your docketalarm.com account.

tools.name: docketalarm_search_pacer
tools.description: Search federal PACER dockets by party — live party-name search across federal PACER (Appellate, Bankruptcy, Civil, Criminal, MDL). Note: this passes live PACER search fees at cost. Returns matching federal cases with court, docket, title, and filing date. Example: docketalarm_search_pacer({ party_name: "Microsoft Corporation", _apiKey: "user@example.com:yourpassword" })

party_name.description: Company or individual party name to search for on PACER.

court_region.description: Optional regional filter to narrow the PACER search.

_apiKey.description: Docket Alarm credentials as "username:password" from your docketalarm.com account.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-docket-alarm forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the docket-alarm pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
